claim: In the salary NP in tree [11], CGEL labels the PP from Lloyds as a complement.
evidence_summary: Compare the printed Comp label with the authors’ published instruction to replace it with Mod. Both use PP for the category and permit the same branching.
finding: Change the dependent’s function label in this tree. Nothing about the correction assigns a uniform function to other from-phrases.
proposed_wording: Label from Lloyds as a modifier (Mod) above PP.
inference: Which dependent function should [11] assign to the particular PP from Lloyds?

evidence.source: CGEL authors. The Cambridge Grammar of the English Language: Typographical and Other Errors.
evidence.passage: §2, p. 332, tree [11]. The PP from Lloyds, following salary, bears the function label Comp. The immediately higher relative clause has a separate attachment.
evidence.example: The authors explicitly replace the complement function label on from Lloyds with modifier. The PP category and the tree’s branching remain as printed.
evidence.establishes: An author-acknowledged change to this analysis.
evidence.locator: Opening numbered list, item 1, and table entry for p. 332, tree [11].
